name: Kinetic / head

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. Head exploding like a ripe pumpkin: deep wet pop, crunchy rupture, broad pulp splatter and dripping.  Element: One heavy bone crack, a deep solid thump and tearing fibers, followed by irregular dense physical fragments scattering and small wet impacts Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
